data.name: Catalina
data.gender_notes: Catalina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Roman name Catalina, derived from the Latin word ‘catus’ meaning ‘pure’ or ‘clear’. The name Catalina carries the meaning “Pure, Clear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Catalina usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine protection and purity
data.etymology: Catalina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Clear.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Catalina total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: קטרינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קטרינה מקורו בשם העברי קתרינה, שפירושו אלוהים הוא הטוב והצדיק שופט. השם נגזר מהמילים 'קתרוס' שפירושו טוהר ו'איין' שפירושו אלוהים. השם קטרינה מופיע בתנ"ך ככינויה של קדושה נוצרייה חשובה.

in_greek.name: Καταλίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καταλίνη προέρχεται από το λατινικό όνομα Catalina, το οποίο προέρχεται από το ελληνικό όνομα Αικατερίνη. Το όνομα σημαίνει καρδιά αγνή και δίκαιος κρίσεως. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Καταλίνη δεν αναφέρεται ρητά, αλλά η σημασία του ονόματος συνδέεται με την έννοια της αγνότητας και της δικαιοσύνης.

in_latin.name: Catalina
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Catalina originem habet ex nomine hebraico Catharina, quod significat mundus et justus. Nomen Catalina in ecclesia primitiva christiana usitatum erat, et significabat personam quae mundo corde et justa mente praedita erat.

in_english.name: Catalina
in_english.meaning: Pure and clear, God is righteous
in_english.long_meaning: The name Catalina originates from the Hebrew name Catharina, meaning pure and clear, and the Greek and Latin roots signify God is righteous. Although not directly mentioned in the Bible, the name Catalina holds significant spiritual meaning in Christian tradition, symbolizing purity, clarity, and divine justice. Historically, the name Catalina has been associated with Saint Catherine, a prominent Christian martyr and philosopher. The name Catalina has been popularized across various Christian cultures, representing virtues of righteousness, compassion, and devotion.

data.cultural_impact: Catalina was a famous Argentine-born actress who rose to international fame in the 1940s and 50s. Her giving name, Catalina, symbolized her pure, clear, and inspiring performances on stage and screen. Her legacy left an indelible mark on Latin American and international cinema.
data.spiritual_significance: Catalina, as a Christian name, represents purity and clarity not just in artistic pursuits, but in one's spiritual life too. It is a reminder to keep our hearts, minds, and souls clean and focused on the divine, just as a clear glass reveals the beauty of the contents within. The name Catalina serves as a constant encouragement for its bearers to strive for moral and ethical excellence, never letting themselves or their faith down.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Catalina: Pure, Clear, and Fiery. A name of Greek origin meaning pure and Clear, like the clear waters of the Mediterranean Sea, with the fiery passion of St. Catherine, the patron saint of the name.
